name: USD Liquidity Command Center — H.4.1 · DTS · H.8/H.15 (desk migration)
treasury: U.S. Treasury — Bureau of the Fiscal Service (Daily Treasury Statement)
monetary_sovereignty: full (currency issuer; floor system with IORB, ON RRP as sub-floor)
framework: Fed ample-reserves floor system: IORB 3.65 (verified 2026-09-09), ON RRP award rate as the sub-floor, SOFR the market rate; balance sheet in QT run-off; TGA at the Fed = fiscal drain/injection; DTS daily flows (T-1); H.8 weekly bank credit; H.15 daily curve

lineage.origin: Sander's three USD dashboards: 'USD Liquidity Command Center — H.4.1' v2.0-AUDIT, 'US Treasury Liquidity Dashboard — DTS Tracker' v3.0-AUDIT, 'H.8 Banking & H.15 Rates Monitor' v2.1-AUDIT (HTML shared 2026-09-08)
lineage.rule: EXACT metric set and thresholds of the three dashboards (no AI triangulation, Sander's instruction 2026-09-08); desk percentiles only as secondary context
corrections_from_primary_sources: H.4.1 v2.0 'UNITS' multiplied WTREGEN and WRESBAL by 1000: FRED publishes both in $ millions (verified 2026-09-08: WRESBAL 2,894,531 = $2.89T; WTREGEN 967,935 = $968B); only RRPONTTLD is $ billions → the legacy Net Liquidity and the WRESBAL/TGA badges were computed on 1000x values (reserves always 'AMPLE', NL ≈ −$1T). Fixed here: all series in $M
H.8 v2.1 'Borrowings (TLBACBW027SBOG)': that id is Total Liabilities, All Commercial Banks; borrowings weekly SA = H8B3094NCBA ($M) (BOWACBW027SBOG discontinued). Fixed
H.8 v2.1 'C&I Loans (BUSLOANS)': BUSLOANS is MONTHLY; the weekly H.8 series is TOTCI ($B, SA). Fixed (BUSLOANS kept as monthly display)
H.15: DFF is a 7-day series, DTB3/DGS2/DGS10 business days → spreads on common dates only (kept from v2.1)
desk_additions: v0.1.1: structural fiscal impulse (ntf_20d, ntf_60d, ntf_fytd_vs_prior_fy, fiscal_impulse) — approved by Sander 2026-09-09

central_bank.title: 1 · Federal Reserve — H.4.1 balance sheet, reserves, drains (weekly) + ON RRP daily
central_bank.equivalence_note: H.4.1 Wednesday levels via FRED (Thu 16:30 ET = 22:30 WAT). Net Liquidity = WALCL − WTREGEN − RRPONTTLD (RRP = latest observation ≤ the H.4.1 date). All $M.

tga.label: TGA — Treasury General Account, weekly average (WTREGEN)

reserves.label: Reserve Balances with Federal Reserve Banks, weekly average (WRESBAL)

net_liquidity.formula: WALCL − WTREGEN − RRPONTTLD (RRP = latest daily ≤ H.4.1 date; weeks without TGA/RRP coverage are skipped, never zero-filled)

tga_status.rule: ≥ 900B HEAVY DRAIN · ≥ 750B DRAIN WATCH · else SAFE (alerts table: > 800B rising = active drain)

rrp_status.rule: ≥ 200B WATCH (capital parked / rebound signal) · else LOW

total_assets_wow.formula: Δ WALCL w/w ($M) — QT ↓ / QE ↑ (assets table)

balance_sheet_phase.rule: 13-week Δ WALCL < −50B → QT; > +50B → QE; else STEADY

reserves.note: H.4.1 rule: <3.0T NERVOUS (WATCH), <2.5T CRITICAL (CRISIS). 3.0–4.0T = 'ample band' for the desk regime (above 4.0T = abundant); the only operative numbers are Sander's 3.0T / 2.5T

primary_credit_wow_pct.note: H.4.1: +20% weekly = PANIC / bank in trouble

net_liquidity_wow_pct.note: H.4.1: ±2% weekly (absolute rule mandatory); percentile only informs

fiscal.title: 2 · U.S. Treasury — Daily Treasury Statement: TGA, deposits, withdrawals, debt, Net Treasury Flow (daily, T-1)
fiscal.equivalence_note: DTS via Fiscal Data API, ~16:00 ET (22:00 WAT), record_date = previous business day. Views Daily / MTD / FYTD kept as fields on every line item. Net Treasury Flow (MMT sign) = (Withdrawals − Debt Redemptions) − (Deposits − Debt Issues): + = net fiscal injection (NFA creation), − = drain. Reserve impact ≠ NFA: −ΔTGA.

net_treasury_flow.stats: rolling 30-business-day mean, σ, Z (population σ, window includes the day, as the DTS Tracker)

net_treasury_flow_7d.formula: sum of the last 7 daily NTF

tga_reserve_impact.formula: −Δ TGA closing d/d (TGA down = reserves added)

seasonal_flag.rule: Quarter-End (3/31, 6/30, 9/30, 12/31) · Tax Day (Apr 14–16) · Est. Tax Day (14–16 of Jan/Jun/Sep) · Mid-Month Settl. (14–16) · Payments Window (≥ 25)

fiscal_regime.rule: daily surprise rule (DTS Tracker) kept for display; the block label/score come from fiscal_impulse

ntf_20d.formula: sum of the last 20 daily NTF
ntf_20d.note: v0.1.1 structural impulse; Z vs 250 sessions

ntf_60d.formula: sum of the last 60 daily NTF
ntf_60d.note: v0.1.1 structural impulse; Z vs 250 sessions; its sign sets the structural direction

ntf_fytd_vs_prior_fy.formula: NTF FYTD / NTF FYTD at the same date of the prior fiscal year − 1 (DTS cumulative fields)

fiscal_impulse.formula: score = 0.5 × structural + 0.5 × surprise; structural = sign(ntf_60d) × clamp(1 + 0.5 × Z60 × sign ± 0.25 if FYTD pace ±10% vs prior FY, 0.5..2); surprise = 0.75 × clamp(Z30) + 0.5 × sign(NTF 7d)
fiscal_impulse.note: v0.1.1 (Sander 2026-09-09): the fiscal block scores the LEVEL of the injection, not only the daily surprise; a sustained deficit is an injection by construction (MMT sign)

tga_closing.note: same TGA bands as H.4.1 applied to the daily close

tga_dod.note: desk context only: a large one-day TGA build = reserve drain day

<series>_wow_pct.status: credit/loans: > 0 EXPANDING · < −0.1 CONTRACTING · else FLAT; C&I: < −0.1 WEAK; deposits: > 0 STABLE · < −0.1 WEAKENING · else FLAT; borrowings: < 0 FALLING · > 0.5 RISING FAST · else STABLE

heatmap_z.formula: Z of each weekly Δ% vs the previous 26 weeks (no lookahead, ≥ 10 points): |Z| > 2 extraordinary, > 1 notable

index_base100.formula: loans / deposits / borrowings rebased to 100 at the first common date of the window (combined chart)

transmission_signal.rule: H.8 v2.1 vote: LL>0, DEP>0, BOR<0, CI>0, BC>0 → green; LL<−0.1, DEP<−0.1, BOR>0.5, CI<−0.1, BC<−0.1 → red; GREEN ≥3 green, RED ≥3 red, YELLOW else, NO SIGNAL <3 valid

rates.title: 4 · Rates & money market — SOFR−IORB stress spread (daily) + H.15 curve: Fed funds, 3M bill, 2Y, 10Y
rates.equivalence_note: SOFR (NY Fed, 08:00 ET T+1) and IORB (Board) via FRED; H.15 daily closes via FRED (T+1). Spreads on common dates only (DFF is a 7-day series). STRESS SPREAD = SOFR − IORB: 0–5 SAFE · 5–15 WATCH · >15 STRESS · >30 CRISIS (H.4.1 badge: NORMAL / STRESS / CRITICAL).

sofr_minus_iorb_bps.role: STRESS SPREAD; friction_confirmed = > 15 bp on the latest print and on ≥ 1 of the 2 prior sessions (desk persistence so a month-end print alone never flips the regime)

curve_10y_2y_bps.status: < −50 DEEP INVERSION · < 0 INVERTED · < 50 FLAT · else STEEPENING (overlay: < 25 FLAT CURVE)

ff_minus_3m_bps.status: > 30 TIGHT · > 10 ELEVATED · else NORMAL; FF > 3M = market prices cuts

rates_signal.rule: H.15 v2.1: RED if 10Y−2Y < −20 and FF−3M > 20 · GREEN if 10Y−2Y > 0 and FF−3M < 10 · else YELLOW; NO SIGNAL if a spread is missing

forex_signal_matrix.rule: H.4.1: NL Δ% RISK-ON/OFF · SOFR−IORB > 30 FUNDING STRESS, > 15 FUNDING WATCH (heurística heredada, sin replay, sin dirección) · WRESBAL < 3T NERVOUS · TGA ≥ 800B HIGH DRAIN

sofr_minus_iorb_bps.note: H.4.1: 0–5 safe · 15–30 stress · > 30 crisis (5–15 = watch band in the chart)

ust_10y_5d_change_bps.note: desk context (same as NZD/CHF): 5-session move in the 10Y

regime.weights_note: desk proposal (no triangulation for USD): DTS is one of Sander's three dashboards and is daily → fiscal 0.25; recalibrate with live history

rules.LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY: WRESBAL below 3.0T (WATCH+) AND SOFR − IORB ≥ STRESS (> 15 bp)
rules.FLOOR_FRICTION: reserves in/above the ample band AND SOFR − IORB friction_confirmed
rules.LIQUIDITY_DRAIN: general regime: central bank AND treasury both DRAIN, or dual-weighted score ≤ drain threshold (regime.dual)
rules.LIQUIDITY_INJECTION: general regime: both INJECTION, or dual-weighted score ≥ injection threshold (regime.dual)
rules.NEUTRAL: otherwise (including unresolved conflicts inside the thresholds)

orthogonal_flags.NTF_EXTRAORDINARY: |Z| ≥ 2 on the daily Net Treasury Flow

calibration.method: after ≥ 26 weeks live: grid over weights scored against SOFR − IORB > 15 episodes

dual.status: calibrated by replay 2026-09-09 (engine v0.3, era 2022-06-01, 223 weeks)

central_bank.rule: era p80/p20 (exit p67/p33) of the 7-day mean score, nearest attainable, exit after 0 days inside

fiscal.rule: era p80/p20 (exit p67/p33) of the 7-day mean score, nearest attainable, exit after 0 days inside

dual.rule: three regimes per currency (engine v0.3): central_bank and fiscal from their block score with era-calibrated entry/exit cuts on the 7-day mean score; general = agreement only (both inject → LIQUIDITY_INJECTION, both drain → LIQUIDITY_DRAIN, partial or conflict → NEUTRAL labelled); percentile windows anchored to era_start; price gates (LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY, FLOOR_FRICTION) override the general regime

regime.composite_note: weights (4 blocks) now produce the desk composite score for context; the reported regime is the general regime (central bank + treasury)

dual_v02.rule: three regimes per currency: central_bank (block score), fiscal (block score), general = agreement (both inject → LIQUIDITY_INJECTION, both drain → LIQUIDITY_DRAIN); a conflict is resolved by the dual-weighted score against general_thresholds; price gates (LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY, FLOOR_FRICTION) override the general regime
